case.title: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH, Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o., Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH. RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series. Need: 4200 pc a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 35 days). There is no fallback supplier: without a deal the demand is bought at the fallback price. Must-haves: lead_time_days <= 42. Prepare from the data package.

messages.subject: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hallo,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is good to hear from you again. For this work, we can offer a price of €36.00 per unit. We have our CNC machines ready and look forward to putting this job onto the shop floor for you. 

Let me know if this works for you so we can get started soon.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Dear Mr Dralveck,

Thank you for your quick offer for the HX pump shaft, and for your readiness to put it on your machines. We value the years of reliable cooperation between our two family companies and would like to find a fair solution together.

To be open with you, two points weigh on our side:
Your quality was 1863 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70210@2026Q3).
Another supplier has offered EUR 31.50 for this part (offer:70240-0).

We would still prefer to keep this part with you.
We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 31.78; payment 60 days net; lead time 35 days.
Option B: unit price EUR 30.85; payment 45 days net; lead time 35 days.
Option C: unit price EUR 31.57; payment 30 days net; lead time 35 days.

Each option is a genuine proposal. If faster payment matters more to you, the shorter terms are there for that. We look forward to your reply.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hallo,

We can accept your terms and await your order. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price. We take the complaints seriously; our 8D report is attached. Our current defect rate for you is about 1200 ppm. 

We need to keep the 30 days payment to keep our shop running smoothly. Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C2431, AS-14404, PPI-D351. Our Angebot is a price of €31.57 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

messages.subject: Quote from Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are very eager to work together with you and to prove ourselves as a reliable, long-term partner for your business!

We are happy to offer you a price of €31.50 per unit, Lieferzeit 52 days. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We really look forward to hearing from you soon and hope we can start a great cooperation!

Kind regards
Jana Procházková
Export Manager, Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Dear Ms Procházková,

Thank you for your quick and friendly offer for the HX pump shaft. We share your interest in building a reliable, long-term partnership.

Before we settle terms, two points from our data shape our view of the price and lead time:

Your on-time delivery was 62.5% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70240@2026Q3).

German labour costs in manufacturing changed +2.7% from 2025-06 to 2026-06 (idx:LCI-C@2025-06, idx:LCI-C@2026-06).

With that in mind, we have prepared three options for you:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 28.85; payment 60 days net; lead time 35 days.
Option B: unit price EUR 28.01; payment 45 days net; lead time 35 days.
Option C: unit price EUR 28.75; payment 45 days net; lead time 35 days.

Each option gives both sides clear planning security on the new series. Option B offers the sharpest price with faster payment, while Option A pairs a different price with a longer payment period. We would be glad to hear which suits you best.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Your figures confirm our case: that driver rose. Thanks for the options! I hear you on the delivery record, we had some hiccups last year but we sorted them out.

Our offer is a price of €34.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days.

35 days lead time is too tight for us and would push the price up, so I changed it to 52 days to give you a better deal. As an alternative, I can lower the price to €31.00 per unit with 52 days lead time and 45 days payment. This package offers a price of €31.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 52 days at standard terms.

Our offer remains valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Jana Procházková
Export Manager, Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.
